segments.sn17.12:1.3: idhāhaṃ, bhikkhave, ekaccaṃ puggalaṃ evaṃ cetasā ceto paricca pajānāmi –
segments.sn17.12:1.4: ‘na cāyamāyasmā rūpiyapātiyāpi suvaṇṇacuṇṇaparipūrāya hetu sampajānamusā bhāseyyā’ti.
segments.sn17.12:1.5: Tamenaṃ passāmi aparena samayena lābhasakkārasilokena abhibhūtaṃ pariyādiṇṇacittaṃ sampajānamusā bhāsantaṃ.
segments.sn17.12:1.6: Evaṃ dāruṇo kho, bhikkhave, lābhasakkārasiloko … pe …

lines: 167-168. Dutiyavaggassa paṭhame sampajānamusā bhāsantanti appamattakenapi kāraṇena sampajānameva musā bhāsantaṃ.
“Sīlaṃ pūressāmī”ti saṃvihitabhikkhuṃ sinerumattopi paccayarāsi cāletuṃ na sakkoti.
Yadā pana sīlaṃ pahāya sakkāranissito hoti, tadā kuṇḍakamuṭṭhihetupi musā bhāsati, aññaṃ vā akiccaṃ karoti.
Aññaṃ vā kiccaṃ karoti pageva sīlassa chaḍḍitattā.
